summaries.Romania: Romania faces a critical energy crisis as the Danube hits historic lows, threatening nuclear power generation at Cernavodă, while Parliament debates controversial amendments to decarbonization laws that could jeopardize PNRR funds. Political tensions simmer over integrity law amendments and disputed sanctions on officials.
summaries.Healthcare: The healthcare innovation landscape is rapidly evolving with AI-driven clinical trial platforms, expanded access programs for obesity drugs, and drone delivery systems entering hospitals, while payers grapple with pricing negotiations and data transparency challenges. New startup solutions target hospital-acquired infections, mental health support, and personalized preventive care.
summaries.Tech: Apple faces mounting pressure from the OpenAI trade secrets lawsuit while preparing a major September iPhone event, as competitors like SpaceX and Samsung advance robotaxi services and foldable technology. The AI infrastructure boom continues to reshape the industry, with data center demand straining power grids and driving massive AI compute partnerships.

items.title: Dunărea a ajuns la un nou minim istoric. „Este o cursă contra cronometru”. Scufundarea barjelor pentru devierea apei, incertă
items.snippet: Dunărea a atins miercuri, cu două zile mai devreme decât estimaseră hidrologii, un nou debit minim istoric, a declarat Ana Maria Agiu, purtătorul de cuvânt de la „Apele Române”, la Digi24. Astăzi, este așteptată scufundarea a patru barje care să dirijeze apa către Centrala Cernavodă, însă operațiune
items.line: Danube reaches historic minimum two days ahead of schedule, threatening Cernavodă nuclear plant cooling water and forcing emergency interventions to maintain power generation.

items.title: BREAKING | Legea decarbonizării a fost adoptată de Camera Deputaților cu amendamentul PSD / România riscă penalități și blocarea cererilor de plată 5 și 6 din PNRR
items.snippet: Plenul Camerei Deputaţilor a adoptat, miercuri, 5 august, proiectul de lege privind decarbonizarea sectorului energetic în care a fost introdus un amendament al PSD potrivit căruia scoaterea treptată din exploatare a capacităţilor de producţie de energie electrică pe bază de lignit şi huilă se va pu
items.line: Parliament adopts controversial decarbonization law amendments that risk nearly €1 billion in PNRR funds by blocking coal plant closures without alternative energy sources ready.

items.title: STAT+: Exemption of rare disease therapies in drug-pricing pilots would wipe out huge savings, analysis finds
items.snippet: Excluding rare disease therapies from a Medicare pilot program to lower drug prices would wipe out much of the savings from retail drugs, according to new research.
items.line: Analysis shows excluding rare disease therapies from Medicare drug pricing pilots would eliminate most cost savings, raising questions about how to balance innovation incentives with affordability.

items.title: Ebola kills 1,700 in eastern Congo as the fastest-growing outbreak surges
items.snippet: Ebola has killed more than 1,700 people in eastern Congo in what has become the fastest-growing outbreak of the disease.
items.line: Ebola outbreak in eastern Congo becomes the fastest-growing on record with over 1,700 deaths, prompting global health emergency response and new vaccine trials.

items.title: Apple moves for preliminary injunction in OpenAI trade secrets lawsuit
items.snippet: Apple has filed a request for a preliminary injunction in its ongoing trade secrets lawsuit against OpenAI. Without a preliminary injunction, Apple says it will be “irreparably harmed” by the theft of its trade secrets.
items.line: Apple seeks preliminary injunction in OpenAI lawsuit, arguing irreparable harm from alleged theft of trade secrets related to Siri and other AI technologies.

items.title: SpaceX doubles revenue on Anthropic and Google compute deals, Starlink growth
items.snippet: SpaceX doubled its revenue compared to last year, according to its first quarterly earnings since going public in June.
items.line: SpaceX doubles revenue through massive compute deals with Anthropic and Google, signaling that AI infrastructure partnerships now rival space launch revenue.

items.title: Noua Lege a Integrității ajunge la vot final în Parlament. Ceartă pe averile partenerilor: „Cu amantele nu sunt relații ca între soți”
items.snippet: Noua lege a integrității intră astăzi în dezbaterea finală din Senat, însă nu este lipsită de controverse. items.line: Integrity law amendments spark fierce debate over partner asset declarations, with PSD using ANI regulations as a political weapon against USR officials like Dominic Fritz.

items.title: QuantHealth Snags $45M to Simulate Clinical Trials Before Patients Ever Enroll
items.snippet: QuantHealth raised $45 million in Series B funding to expand its AI platform, which simulates clinical trials before they run and predicts patient outcomes for pharma companies. The startup is aiming to cut the industry’s 90% trial failure rate and speed up the timelines for effective drugs to reach
items.line: QuantHealth raises $45M Series B to scale AI platform that simulates clinical trials before enrollment, aiming to reduce pharma's 90% trial failure rate.

items.title: Apple lawsuit against OpenAI says iCloud mess didn’t play a role
items.snippet:
One of the theories voiced about how a former Apple employee may have accessed confidential documents after leaving the company to join OpenAI has been dispelled by a court filing.
It has been suggested that access to the documents may have been inadvertent due to a seemingly messy iCloud arrangemen
items.line: Apple's lawsuit against OpenAI reveals iCloud access was not the vector for alleged trade secret theft, narrowing the scope of how confidential documents reached the AI company.

items.title: Waymo opens up robotaxi service in Dallas to everyone
items.snippet: Waymo has dropped the waitlist for its robotaxi service in Dallas, the latest step in the company's bid to scale its self-driving technology across the United States, U.K., and Europe.
items.line: Waymo removes waitlist for Dallas robotaxi service, accelerating commercial deployment and setting stage for nationwide autonomous vehicle competition with Tesla and others.

items.title: Texas halts data center connections to power grid amid overwhelming demand
items.snippet: Governor who touted Texas as AI “epicenter” pauses data center grid connections.
items.line: Texas halts new data center grid connections as demand for AI infrastructure overwhelms power supply, forcing recalibration of the state's tech growth strategy.

items.title: EA is now a private company
items.snippet: Electronic Arts has officially become a private company. items.line: Electronic Arts completes $55B privatization deal with Saudi PIF, Silver Lake, and Affinity Partners, removing the gaming giant from public markets amid industry consolidation.
